mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship holds consistently across monetary policy cycles without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings contraction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint deterioration of unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) and residential sales (RSAFS < 350000 million) signals severe economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through compounded demand destruction.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect (regression coefficient) is not statistically significant (p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 (2017=100) signals overheating and impending monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 105.0 and the economy is in late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in late-cycle is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High residential sales (RSAFS) reflect robust consumer demand and business investment, which typically supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 350,000 million, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 110.0 (2017=100) indicates robust manufacturing activity, which typically precedes stronger corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 110.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) and low employment levels (PAYEMS < 135000 thousand) indicates labor market contraction, which typically causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction term in a regression model is not significant (p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 220.0 (1982-1984=100) signals rising inflation pressures, which typically prompts monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 220.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
